title: PORT-BRANCH-agent-no-open-items-1: carry agent/no-open-items-1 onto main
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** branch `agent/no-open-items-1` at 1b6ed239c4 holds work main lacks and cannot merge as is (conflicts in code: doctrine/open-loops.json, tests/foundation/test_openloops.py)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation branchsweep --carried agent/no-open-items-1
**Status:** open

Port the change by hand onto current main (it is 1 commit(s) ahead), keeping tests green; then the sweep deletes the branch. Once idle the branch moves to `refs/archive/agent/no-open-items-1` (`git fetch origin refs/archive/agent/no-open-items-1`).

size: M

**Closing probe:** python3 -m foundation branchsweep --carried agent/no-open-items-1
